explication: Presto is a distributed SQL query engine: clients submit SQL to a server, which manages query execution and exposes query information; connectors integrate data systems. The graph includes the documented CLI and console capabilities, sampled query-management and execution components, and the BigQuery connector as a concrete integration. Relationships are limited to README statements and SOURCE INDEX references or excerpts; dashed edges mark workflow links whose implementation was not shown.
